problem: Determine the value of the geometric series ${\sum }_{n=0}^{7}8{(\frac{3}{5})}^{n-1}$ rounded to $3$ decimal places.
worked_solution:
Since the given series is in the form $\sum a{r}^{n-1},$ it is a geometric series. Notice that the index starts from $n=0$ instead of $n=1.$

To determine the sum, we use the formula for the sum ${S}_{N}$ of a geometric series.

$$
{S}_{N}={a}_{0}\frac{(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}
$$

In this case, $r=\frac{3}{5}.$ Also, note that $N=8,$ since there are $8$ terms in total.

The formula for the $n$th term of the series is

$$
{a}_{n}=8{(\frac{3}{5})}^{n-1},
$$

and so the first term ${a}_{0}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{0} & =8{(\frac{3}{5})}^{0-1} \\  & =8{(\frac{3}{5})}^{-1} \\  & =8(\frac{5}{3}) \\  & =\frac{40}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

If we substitute ${a}_{0}=\frac{40}{3}\,,r=\frac{3}{5}$ and $N=8$ into the formula for ${S}_{N}$, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{8} & =\frac{40}{3}\cdot \frac{[1-{(\frac{3}{5})}^{8}]}{(1-\frac{3}{5})} \\  & =\frac{40}{3}\cdot \frac{[1-{(\frac{3}{5})}^{8}]}{(\frac{2}{5})} \\  & =\frac{100}{3}\cdot [1-{(\frac{3}{5})}^{8}] \\  & ≈32.773\end{aligned}
$$

Note that the final answer has been rounded to three decimal places.
